visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An AI-generated ginger tabby cat wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt with a floral pattern is bouncing on a black trampoline. The cat is captured mid-air with its paws outstretched and mouth wide open in a meow expression. The setting is a bright, sunlit suburban backyard featuring a clear blue swimming pool, a wooden fence, and green trees. A small white logo "RT" is visible in the top left corner. (2) The scene transitions to a different ginger cat wearing full-body blue pajamas. It jumps high into the air, its paws curled inward. The background shifts to show more of the garden area and the exterior of a two-story house. The lighting remains natural and bright, emphasizing the vibrant blue of the cat's outfit and the pool water in the distance. (3) A black and white cat and subsequently a fluffy white cat, both dressed in blue shirts or pajamas, are shown performing similar jumps. Their facial expressions vary from alert to neutral. The camera remains at eye level, focusing on the center of the trampoline. The pool area provides a consistent, high-contrast background with sparkling water and poolside furniture. (4) Finally, a large black cat wearing a blue shirt and shorts set makes a series of leaps before jumping off the side of the trampoline. It is seen falling into the pool, creating a massive white splash of water that fills the lower half of the frame. The house and surrounding foliage are visible in the background as the cat disappears into the water.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track commences with a high-energy, upbeat pop-funk background music characterized by a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat and a melodic, groovy bassline. The music maintains a constant tempo of approximately 128 BPM and a bright, major-key tonality. Synthesizer stabs provide rhythmic accents throughout the track. There are no human vocals or speech, and the ambient noise floor is practically non-existent, indicating a clean studio-produced track. (2) As the music continues without interruption, a sudden and loud splash sound effect is introduced. This sound event has a broad spectral bandwidth, characteristic of a significant volume of liquid being displaced by an impact. The splash is the only non-musical sound event in this phase, serving as a synchronized auditory cue for the visual action of the cat falling into the water. The music persists with its consistent rhythm until the track concludes.
